Panic Device for Narrow Stile Doors

text.description_html:
FAL-19-R-EO-4FT, Panic Device for Narrow Stile Doors

The Falcon 19-R Series rim device that delivers superior panic hardware with modern touchbar styling. This non-handed device covers a 161 cutout and may be used on 1 -/4 inch narrow stile aluminum doors. The EO (exit only) device is ready to accept any trim function.

Features of the Falcon 19-R-EO-4FT Narrow Stile Exit Device:

  • ANSI Grade 1 rating
  • Comes packaged with all mounting hardware.

Specifications of the Rim Type Touch Bar Exit Device:

  • Finish: SP313 finish, painted dark bronze
  • Projection: 2-1/2” max., 1-7/8” dogged
  • Stile: Minimum Stile 1-3/4”
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4” thick
  • Dogging: 1/2" turn hex key in touch bar
  • End caps: Black plastic end caps.
  • For doors from 3' up to 4'.
  • Latch: Stainless steel, 3/4" throw dead locking.
  • Handing: Field Reversible

Sold Individually. Packaged as Exit Device Only - No Trim.
